description: Charming house with character in the heart of Paris, combining the charm of the old with modern comfort.It has 5 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, a fully equipped kitchen, a living room, a dining room and 2 balconies.Ideally located near the Marais and Bastille, with shops, restaurants, markets, metro, buses, taxis and Vélib' within walking distance.Perfect for families, groups of friends or business travellers. Park with playground nearby.The spaceThis spacious entire apartment, located on the 1st floor of a magnificent period building, offers a quiet and bright setting.It consists of:- 5 bedrooms- 3 bathrooms (each pair of bedrooms has direct access to a bathroom) – see plan- A living room- A dining room- A fully equipped kitchen- Two balconiesEach bedroom has direct access to a modern bathroom.In the bedrooms, you will find:- High-end bedding (single or double beds)- Cotton or linen household linen- A safe- A wardrobe- Heating in winter, ventilation in summer- New: Air conditioning (summer)- Authentic Parisian decorSleeping arrangements:- Bedroom 1: double bed (180x200 cm) or two single beds (90x200 cm) > Please let us know your preference. This room has a balcony and direct access to a bathroom with a toilet.- Bedroom 2: single bed (80x190 cm), option to add an extra single bed. Direct access to a bathroom with toilet.- Bedroom 3: double bed (160x190 cm), direct access to a bathroom with toilet.- Bedroom 4: double bed (160x190 cm), direct access to a bathroom with toilet.- Bedroom 5: single bed (80x190 cm), option to add an extra single bed. This room has a balcony and direct access to a bathroom with a toilet.- Are you travelling with a baby?
